tools.name: createFolder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in the virtual file system. Use this when the user asks to create a directory or folder.

name.description: The name of the new folder.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent folder. Pass null if creating at the root level.

tools.name: uploadImage
tools.description: Uploads an image file to a specific folder. Use this when the user asks to upload or save an image.

folderId.description: The ID of the folder where the image should be uploaded. Pass null for root level.

filePath.description: The local absolute path to the image file to be uploaded.
